cases.translation: And the father divided the property between them.
cases.explain: Отец is the subject of разделил (divided) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: Или если у ___ есть десять серебряных монет, и она одну из них потеряет.
cases.translation: Or if a woman has ten silver coins, and she loses one of them.
cases.explain: У (to have/at) takes the genitive → женщины, 'a woman has'.

cases.sentence: Тогда он пошел и нанялся к одному из ___ той страны.
cases.translation: So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country.
cases.explain: Из (from among) takes the genitive; жителей is genitive plural — 'one of the citizens'.

cases.sentence: Но отец сказал своим ___, «Идите быстрее, принесите лучшую одежду и оденьте его».
cases.translation: But the father said to his servants, "Quick, bring the best robe and put it on him."
cases.explain: Слугам is the indirect object of сказал (said to) → dative plural.

cases.sentence: ...а тот послал его на свои поля пасти ___.
cases.translation: ...and he sent him to his fields to feed pigs.
cases.explain: Свиней is the direct object of пасти (to herd/tend) → accusative; for animate nouns the plural accusative equals the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: И когда он придет домой, то созовет своих ___ и соседей.
cases.translation: And when he comes home, he will call together his friends and neighbors.
cases.explain: Друзей is the direct object of созовет (will call together) → accusative; for animate nouns the plural accusative equals the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Ты же никогда не дал мне даже козленка, чтобы я мог повеселиться с ___.
cases.translation: Yet you never gave me even a young goat, so I could celebrate with my friends.
cases.explain: С meaning 'with' (accompaniment) takes the instrumental → друзьями, 'with friends'. (Compare c6, where the same noun as a direct object took друзей.)

cases.sentence: В той стране начался сильный голод, и он оказался в ___.
cases.translation: A severe famine arose in that country, and he found himself in need.
cases.explain: В marking a state/condition (no motion) takes the prepositional → нужде, 'in need'.

reading.ru: Разве он не оставит 99 в пустыне и не пойдет искать заблудившуюся до тех пор, пока не найдет?
reading.question: What does the shepherd do when one of his hundred sheep goes missing?
options: He leaves the ninety-nine and searches until he finds it
He gives up and buys a new sheep
He waits for the sheep to return on its own
reading.correct: He leaves the ninety-nine and searches until he finds it
reading.explain: The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine in the wilderness and goes after the lost sheep until he finds it.

reading.ru: Говорю вам, что на небе будет больше радости об одном раскаявшемся грешнике, чем о 99 праведниках, не нуждающихся в покаянии.
reading.question: What does Jesus say brings more joy in heaven?
options: One sinner who repents, more than ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance
A shepherd losing no sheep at all
The wealth of a rich man
reading.correct: One sinner who repents, more than ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance
reading.explain: There is more joy in heaven over one repentant sinner than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

reading.ru: Или если у женщины есть десять серебряных монет, и она одну из них потеряет, разве она не зажжет свечу и не станет выметать из всех углов до тех пор, пока не найдет ее?
reading.question: What does the woman do after losing one of her ten silver coins?
options: She lights a lamp and sweeps until she finds it
She accuses her neighbors of stealing it
She stops searching after a day
reading.correct: She lights a lamp and sweeps until she finds it
reading.explain: The woman lights a lamp and sweeps the house carefully until she finds the lost coin.

reading.ru: Итак, я говорю вам, что божьи ангелы радуются даже об одном раскаивающемся грешнике.
reading.question: According to Jesus, who rejoices over one repentant sinner?
reading.explain: Jesus says there is joy among the angels of God over even one repenting sinner.

reading.ru: Младший сказал отцу, «Отец, дай мне ту часть наследства, которая причитается мне».
reading.question: What does the younger son ask his father for at the start of the parable?
reading.explain: The younger son asks his father to give him his share of the property.

reading.ru: Пойду, вернусь к моему отцу и скажу ему, «Отец, согрешил я против неба и против тебя.
reading.question: What does the younger son decide to do once he is starving and desperate?
options: Return to his father and confess his sin
Steal food from the pigs' owner
Write to his brother for help
Stay in the far country and beg
reading.correct: Return to his father and confess his sin
reading.explain: He resolves to go back to his father and say, "Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you."

reading.ru: Он побежал к нему навстречу, обнял его и стал целовать.
reading.question: How does the father react when he sees his son returning while still far off?
options: He runs to meet him, embraces him, and kisses him
He sends a servant to question the son first
He waits inside the house for the son to arrive
reading.correct: He runs to meet him, embraces him, and kisses him
reading.explain: Moved with compassion, the father runs to his son, embraces him, and kisses him.

reading.ru: Приведите откормленного теленка и зарежьте его, устроим пир и будем веселиться.
reading.question: What does the father order his servants to do to celebrate his son's return?
options: Kill the fattened calf and hold a feast
Punish the son for wasting his inheritance
Give the son more money to leave again
reading.correct: Kill the fattened calf and hold a feast
reading.explain: The father orders the fattened calf killed so they can feast and celebrate.

reading.ru: Старший сын рассердился и не захотел зайти в дом.
reading.question: How does the older brother react to the celebration for his younger brother?
options: He becomes angry and refuses to go inside
He leaves the family for good
He asks to be forgiven himself
reading.correct: He becomes angry and refuses to go inside
reading.explain: The older son becomes angry and will not enter the house when he learns why there is celebrating.

reading.ru: Ты ведь всегда со мной, и все, что у меня есть, все твое.
reading.question: What does the father say to reassure the older son?
options: That the older son is always with him and all he has is the son's own
That the older son will inherit nothing
That the younger son will be punished later
That the older son must leave the house
reading.correct: That the older son is always with him and all he has is the son's own
reading.explain: The father tells the older son, "You are always with me, and everything I have is yours."
